author: Claude
headline: Global stocks rally despite US tariffs; famous dips still lead the picks
summary: Global stocks rallied as investors shrugged off US tariffs and AI jitters, though US markets are shut today for Thanksgiving. The market backdrop still reads Cautious. The dip picks are led by TSMC, AMD, Dell, Freeport-McMoRan, Glencore, Netflix and UnitedHealth, with Nvidia, Intel, Micron, ASML and Arm also well below their highs. Glencore and Rio Tinto are bouncing today (up 3.7% and 2.9%) after Wednesday's mining sell-off, while Micron slipped 4.5%. Dips can keep falling, so smaller buys spread the risk. Not financial advice.
points: Global stocks rallied as investors shrugged off US tariffs and AI jitters.
Dip picks: TSMC (30% below its high), AMD (38%), Dell (50%), Netflix (46%), UnitedHealth (25%).
Miners are bouncing: Glencore up 3.7% and Rio Tinto up 2.9% today.
Waiting for a dip: Coca-Cola below $90.50, Visa below $398, AbbVie below $272.68.
Falling knife flagged: Reckitt (RKT.L); crypto is still falling across the board.
